document: Northfield Institute of Technology - Student Academic Policy Handbook, Edition 5.0 (fictional test document)
notes: Section numbers refer to the numbered headings in the handbook; page numbers are intentionally omitted.
For exception questions, 'sections' lists the section where the answer appears first, then the general rule it modifies.
For multi-section questions the answer needs facts from every listed section.
Amounts are in the fictional currency Marel (MRL).

questions.question: What is the minimum percentage of scheduled class sessions a student must attend in a course to be eligible for the end-semester examination in that course?
How many teaching days does a full semester contain?
questions.answer: 80 teaching days (16 teaching weeks of 5 teaching days).

questions.question: After how many hours is a notice posted on the Student Portal deemed received by the student?
questions.answer: 48 hours after posting.

questions.question: What is the application fee for admission, and is it refundable?
questions.answer: MRL 1,000; it is not refundable.

questions.question: How many contact hours of laboratory work represent one credit?
questions.answer: 32 contact hours of laboratory work per semester (16 for lectures or tutorials).

questions.question: What two minimums must a student reach to pass a theory course?
questions.answer: At least 40% of the total marks and at least 35% of the maximum marks in the end-semester examination.

questions.question: What similarity score causes a written assignment to be referred automatically to the Academic Integrity Panel?
questions.answer: A score above 40% (a score above 25% triggers faculty review only).

questions.question: By what time must hostel residents be inside their residence block?
questions.answer: 22:00 (the gates reopen at 05:30).

questions.question: What is the maximum number of semesters of leave of absence a student may take during a programme?
questions.answer: 2 semesters.

questions.question: How many members does the Student Grievance Committee have?
questions.answer: Six: the Dean of Student Welfare (chair), two faculty members, two student representatives and one nominee of the Registrar.

questions.question: How many books may a postgraduate student borrow from the library, and for how long?
questions.answer: 10 books for 30 days.

questions.question: What is the minimum length, and the credit value, of the mandatory B.Tech internship?
questions.answer: At least 8 weeks, worth 6 credits.

questions.question: How many annual seats does the B.Sc. Applied Data Science programme have?
questions.answer: 120 seats.

questions.question: A student has 65% attendance in a course. What is the consequence and the condonation fee?
questions.answer: Eligible only after condonation approved by the Dean of Academic Affairs (60% to below 70% band); fee MRL 2,500 per course.

questions.question: How many grade points does a student receive for a total of 72% in a course?
questions.answer: 8 grade points (letter grade B+, band 70 to 79).

questions.question: On what dates are the Spring 2027 end-semester examinations held?
What is the tuition fee per semester for the M.Tech programme?
What percentage of the tuition fee is refunded if a withdrawal notice is received 30 days after the semester start date?
questions.answer: 30% (band: 22 to 35 days after the start date).

questions.question: Which merit scholarship tier gives a 50% tuition waiver, what is its minimum CGPA, and how many awards are made per year?
questions.answer: Tier 2, the Northfield Excellence Award; minimum CGPA 8.50; 40 annual awards.

questions.question: A B.Tech student submits a withdrawal notice on the Student Portal that the Registrar receives on 17 August 2026. How much tuition fee is refunded?
questions.answer: MRL 25,200. The Autumn 2026 semester starts on 3 August 2026, so the notice date is 14 days after the start date, in the 8 to 21 day band (60% refund). 60% of the B.Tech tuition fee of MRL 42,000 is MRL 25,200. (The library and IT fee is not refunded in this band.)

questions.question: In a course with 40 scheduled sessions, a student attended 22 sessions. A further 8 of the missed sessions fell on days of approved medical leave (6 teaching days of medical leave in total). Is the student eligible for the end-semester examination in that course?
questions.answer: Yes. Approved medical leave sessions count as attended, so attendance is (22 + 8) / 40 = 75%, which meets the 75% minimum.

questions.question: A Tier 1 scholarship holder earns 40 credits in the academic year with no F or XF grade, and the CGPA at the annual review is 8.60. What happens to the scholarship?
questions.answer: The student moves to Tier 2 (Northfield Excellence Award, 50% tuition waiver). The 36-credit and no-F/XF conditions are met, and the CGPA is below the Tier 1 minimum of 9.00 but at least 8.00, so the student moves to the highest tier whose threshold the CGPA meets (Tier 2, minimum 8.50).

questions.question: A B.Tech student has earned 154 credits from courses other than the internship, and has completed the mandatory 8-week internship with result S. Does the student meet the credit requirement for graduation?
questions.answer: Yes. The 6 internship credits count towards the total, so 154 + 6 = 160 credits, which equals the B.Tech requirement of 160.

questions.question: A student has unpaid library dues of MRL 350. Can the student receive a hall ticket for the end-semester examinations?
questions.answer: No. Library dues above MRL 200 create a clearance hold, and a clearance hold blocks the release of hall tickets.

questions.question: A Tier 2 scholarship holder receives a Level 2 academic integrity penalty. What happens to the scholarship?
questions.answer: The scholarship is forfeited for the rest of the academic year in which the penalty is imposed (Level 2 is grade F in the course and disciplinary probation for 1 semester). The student may be considered again at the next annual review.

questions.question: How are class sessions missed during approved medical leave treated for the 75% attendance rule, and is there a limit?
questions.answer: They are counted as attended, up to a maximum of 20 teaching days of medical leave in a semester. This is an exception to the general attendance rule.

questions.question: The hostel curfew is 22:00. Can a resident enter the residence block later than that without a late entry being recorded?
questions.answer: Yes, but only during the study week and the two end-semester examination weeks, and only for residents holding a Late Study Pass: they may enter as late as 00:45. (Exception to the curfew rule.)

questions.question: What is the maximum number of credits a student may register for in a semester in the last two semesters of a programme, and what conditions apply?
questions.answer: Up to 30 credits, if the extra credits are needed to graduate on time; the student needs a CGPA of at least 6.00 and the approval of the Dean of Academic Affairs. (The general undergraduate maximum is 26 credits.)

questions.question: What is the current window and fee for applying for re-evaluation of an end-semester answer script?
questions.answer: Within 10 days of the publication of results, at MRL 600 per course. This is Amendment 1, effective 1 January 2026; it superseded the earlier rule of 7 days and MRL 400 per course.

questions.question: What late fee is charged on tuition and other fees paid after the due date for payments falling due from 1 February 2026?
questions.answer: MRL 500 for each week or part of a week of delay, up to a maximum of MRL 3,000. This is Amendment 2; it superseded the earlier rule of MRL 100 per calendar day, up to MRL 2,000.
